items.title: Basaiawmoit says he declined police security cover
items.summary: UNI reported that Ardent Miller Basaiawmoit said he had declined a Meghalaya Police offer of security cover after being informed of an alleged threat.

items.title: VPP comments on withdrawal of Structured Pay Framework notification
items.summary: Meghalaya Chronicle reported Basaiawmoit saying the withdrawal showed the government had corrected an error; the article also records his criticism of the education administration.

items.title: VPP chief places 10-point charter before Assembly
items.summary: Reporting described demands covering land, recruitment, jobs, influx, industrial projects, education and natural resources.

items.title: VPP chief appeals to all parties to refrain from violence
items.summary: Video coverage of Ardent Miller Basaiawmoit's appeal.
